wargear.name: Vigil banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Sodality's colours, gilded by ten thousand years of ceremony. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Ablative gilding
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A layered auramite coating that sheds blows as a second skin. The model's Invulnerable Save becomes 5+ if it was worse.

wargear.name: Mantle of the Silent
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hunter's cloak woven with null-fibre that dims the wearer to the senses. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+), or one step better if they already have it.

wargear.name: Reliquary plate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A sarcophagus-ward of Auramite lined with the names of the Dreadnought's former masters. The model gains +1 Wound.

wargear.name: Null-gilt pylon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A null-lattice pylon worn at the shoulder, humming against the warp. The bearer gains +1 Willpower and Warp-Sealed.

wargear.name: Oathstone of Reckoning
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A fist-sized stone engraved with the names of the fallen, carried by captains who never forget. Gives the model Vengeance Sworn.

wargear.name: Banner of the Last Gate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall standard that marks where the line will not move. Gives the unit Hold the Gate.

wargear.name: Mirror-gold gilding
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Polished auramite plating that throws back the light of beams and melta-glare. Gives the vehicle Mirror-Gold Hull and +1 Rear armour.

wargear.name: Edict-staff of the Vestarios
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A staff of office bearing the Emperor's own seal, obeyed without question. Gives the unit Voice of the Throne.

wargear.name: Auric sighting-glass
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A lens-and-rangefinder wrought by the Emperor's own artisans. Gives the unit Throne's Eye.

wargear.name: Soul-lamp of the Entombed
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A lamp lit from the Dreadnought's own fading memory. Gives the model Lamp of Remembrance and Feel No Pain (6+).

Zealots of the spearhead: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Marksmen of the Ten Thousand: +1 BS, -1 WS.
Talon hunters: +1 I, -1 LD.
Gilded siege-plate: +1 A, -1 M.
Vigil banner: +1 WP, +1 LD.
Ablative gilding: 5+ Invulnerable Save.
Mantle of the Silent: Shrouded (6+).

modifiers.condition: after a friendly Custodes model within 6" was slain this turn

rites.name: Defenders of the Palace
rites.flavor: The Throne is the last thing that falls, and the Ten Thousand are what stands in front of it.
benefits: Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard Sodalities may fill Troops slots.
They gain Line (1) and Unbroken Watch: they automatically pass Morale and Pinning checks while within 6" of an objective.
limitations: A Shield Captain must be included.
Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard Sodalities must deploy within 12" of an objective.
No Fast Attack, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Defenders of the Palace: Line (1), Unbroken Watch.

require.note: A Shield Captain commands the watch.

rites.name: The Talon Hunt
rites.flavor: Someone in the Palace has a secret. The Ten Thousand and the Talons agree on the remedy.
benefits: Venatari Sodalities may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Assassins gain Infiltrate (6) and Talon Writ: after deployment name one enemy unit as the Quarry; the Assassin adds +1 to Hit Tests against it.
limitations: At least one Venatari Sodality and one Assassin are required.
No War Engine or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Talon Hunt: Line (1).
The Talon Hunt: Infiltrate (6), Talon Writ.

require.note: Bring a Venatari Sodality to run down the quarry.
A Talon of the Emperor must be present.

rites.name: The Emperor's Will
rites.flavor: Valdor does not command the Ten Thousand. He only says aloud what they already know.
benefits: Every Legio Custodes unit gains +1 Willpower and Valdor's Word: it automatically passes Morale and Pinning checks while within 12" of Constantin Valdor.
limitations: Constantin Valdor must lead the army.
No Vagus automata (Castellax, Domitar, Thanatar, Vorax or Vultarax), and at most one War Engine.

modifiers.text: The Emperor's Will: +1 WP, Valdor's Word.

rites.name: The Vigil of Ancients
rites.flavor: Within each Contemptor sleeps a warrior who knew the Emperor before He was called that.
benefits: Contemptor-Galatus, Contemptor-Achillus and Telemon Heavy Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Wakened Ancients: each adds +1 to its Hit Tests against a unit that destroyed a friendly model earlier this phase.
limitations: At least two War Engine units are required.
No Custodian Guard or Sentinel Guard Sodalities.

modifiers.text: The Vigil of Ancients: Line (1), Wakened Ancients.

rules.name: Unbroken Watch
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Defenders of the Palace). A unit with this rule automatically passes Morale and Pinning checks while it is within 6" of an objective.

rules.name: Talon Writ
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Talon Hunt). After both sides deploy, the controller names one enemy unit as this model's Quarry. The model adds +1 to its Hit Tests against the Quarry.

rules.name: Valdor's Word
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Emperor's Will). A unit with this rule automatically passes Morale and Pinning checks while within 12" of Constantin Valdor.

rules.name: Wakened Ancients
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Vigil of Ancients). A model with this rule adds +1 to its Hit Tests against a unit that destroyed a friendly model earlier in the same phase.

rules.name: Warp-Sealed
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Wound from a psychic attack against this model in each phase is ignored.

rules.name: Vengeance Sworn
rules.text: Legacy house rule. After a friendly Custodes model within 6" of the bearer is destroyed, the bearer gains +1 Attack until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Hold the Gate
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While within 3" of an objective, every model in the unit counts as two models when contesting it, and the unit automatically passes Morale checks, but it may not Rush.

rules.name: Mirror-Gold Hull
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Shooting attacks against this vehicle lose Armourbane and Melta (X).

rules.name: Voice of the Throne
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, the unit automatically passes one Morale check it is required to make.

rules.name: Throne's Eye
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The unit ignores Shrouded (X) on its targets and adds +1 to its Hit Tests against Flyers.

rules.name: Lamp of Remembrance
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While an objective is within 12" of this model, it gains Feel No Pain (5+) instead of the usual 6+.

armyRules.name: Aurum Discipline
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Ten thousand years of drill leave the Custodes unmoved by terror, and unable to yield. A unit with this rule automatically passes Pinning checks, but it may never choose to Fall Back.

armyRules.name: Peerless Duellist
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Emperor's champions are trained for single combat above all else. In a Challenge the model adds +1 to its Weapon Skill. The price is pride: it may not decline a Challenge offered by an enemy Champion or Paragon.

armyRules.name: Irreplaceable
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. There are so few of them that every loss is felt across the host. Custodes models gain +1 Cool, but whenever a Custodes unit is destroyed, every other Custodes unit within 12" suffers -1 Cool until the end of the next turn.
